component: OpenPGP import completion and input lifetime

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The checked attachment handler awaits importKeyDataWithConfirmation before removing outFile. The attached-sender-key loop also awaits each confirmation/import in order. The helper resolves true only after successful import and schedules error alerts separately, so awaiting it is not proof every later alert or outer UI command has completed. D252316 supplies brief acceptance only. This is static caller/result inspection, not a cryptographic or UI test.
title: Await attachment-key imports before releasing their temporary input
